moment:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one opaque landscape visual-novel keyframe for Warwrit, 1536x1024 requested, no text.

Create a NEW scene based on the following manuscript moment, not a copy of either input picture. Input image 1 (character.png) is ONLY the selected drawing/rendering/palette reference; do not borrow that man's beard, face, armour, shield, sword or mountains. Input image 2 (forest.png) is ONLY the selected ink/wash environment style reference; do not copy its daytime lighting or geography.

One tense, quiet moment at night behind a wooden cart in a forest clearing: a coarse gray sack is slipping backwards OFF the captive Klim's head, revealing his narrow BEARDLESS face for the first time. He is about 30, thin, short chestnut hair, ordinary adult proportions, frightened eyes looking toward the person offering him a small white handkerchief. His mouth is slightly open, caught before he can explain the deception. No beard, moustache or stubble. The sack is a single coarse gray sack with a ripped side, now sliding across his shoulders and behind his exposed head. Under it he wears an unbleached linen shirt under a plain brown jacket with NO pale patch, gray trousers and worn boots.

Medium shot from wheel-hub height, close enough that his face and both hand actions are readable. Klim sits low on the damp leaf-covered ground next to the REAR cart wheel, on the forest side of the cart. Frame roughly from knees upward. The wheel and high cart side are behind him and form a protective barrier. His anatomical LEFT wrist (viewer RIGHT in a mostly frontal view) is tied by one continuous hemp rope loop to a solid wooden spoke of that wheel. Show the closed rope loop on the wrist, the short connecting rope and its knot around the spoke clearly. A modest red abrasion at the LEFT wrist is caused by struggling against the rope, no blood dripping. That arm remains low and bound. His anatomical RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT), with small blue-black INK stains on fingertips, reaches toward the white handkerchief. Let the ink-stained fingertips hover just above its repaired corner, visibly separate from the cloth. Keep all fingers anatomically connected to the correct arm; the gesture is tentative, not grabbing.

In the lower-left foreground only a neutral player's hand and a small part of a plain dark travel-cloak sleeve are visible. The player crouches outside the frame and offers Pelageya's separate WHITE handkerchief on an open steady hand. The handkerchief is linen, palm sized, recognisably WHITE against brown and charcoal. One corner has a little stitched repair and small brown scorch stain from a pipe, not writing or decoration. This is NOT a headscarf; no woman is present. The cloth stays in the player's hand. Klim is not wounded in either shoulder. A plain wooden bowl has been set on the ground beside his right knee, secondary and unobtrusive.

The cart is a practical old timber cart, fixed high intact board side behind Klim toward the unseen fire, low broken side toward the forest. Cold subdued moonlight from upper left makes his skin, white cloth, ink fingers and rope contact legible; very faint indirect warm fire bounce from behind the boards, no visible fire or orange floodlight. Dark forest beyond the calm cart silhouette; wet leaves and slight matte dampness at lower hems only, no rain or soaking. Hidden farther behind the cart is a body, but do NOT show a body, limb, beard, corpse-shaped bundle, grave or revealing branches in this image. Vasily, the other mercenaries and the bandits are entirely outside this crop.

Selected Warwrit style: mature restrained graphic-novel illustration, confident irregular hand-inked major contours, broad matte flat washes and coherent dark shadow masses, selective interior strokes for wood, hemp, linen, worn leather. Desaturated slate, soot, umber, restrained ochre and moss olive; naturally warm readable skin. Deliberate negative space, clear focal silhouette, quiet secondary surfaces; highest local contrast on face, hands, white cloth and rope contact. Natural adult anatomy and credible humble clothing. Avoid photographic surfaces, smooth CGI, glossy highlights, evenly distributed microtexture, dense crosshatching over every surface, cute forms, hero poses, decorative borders, collage, panels, lettering, emblems, runes, gods, magic glow, logos, watermark, modern clothing or weapons. One cohesive full-bleed illustration.
